newsitem.title: USA: Algos in research pact on heroin treatment.
newsitem.headline: Algos in research pact on heroin treatment.

text.p: Algos Pharmaceutical Corp said Monday it entered a cooperative research and development agreement with the National Institute on Drug Abuse of the National Institutes of Health to evaluate Algos' new drug for heroin addiction treatment.

The National Institute on Drug Abuse will fund up to five clinical studies to assess the new drug's ability to prevent or reduce addict relapse to illicit opiates, a news release issued by Algos said.
The studies will measure safety, withdrawal intensity, cross-tolerance and relapse, the news release said.
